overview_description.description: Vertice provides an intelligent, AI-powered procurement platform for finance and procurement teams. The company offers intake-to-procure workflows that capture requests, route approvals and orchestrate purchasing across existing business tools. Vertice delivers SaaS purchasing capabilities that centralize software spend, renewals, usage analytics and vendor negotiations. Its expert services team supports organizations with procurement strategy, contract negotiation and cost reduction. Vertice supplies pricing data and benchmark analytics across thousands of vendors to inform purchasing decisions and forecasts. The platform also includes Vertice AI agents to automate procurement tasks and a cloud cost optimization solution that analyzes cloud environments, identifies savings opportunities and helps manage commitments.
